facts.text: Serve dessert when Mr Freeze freezes the charity auction.
facts.why: Ivy's pitch is a diamond auction for charity. Freeze crashes it and freezes the guests, and Gordon is told to thaw them.

facts.text: The diamond auction at the Gotham botanical gardens.
facts.why: Ivy says the auction raises money for the botanical gardens. No source places it at the gardens.
facts.fix: The diamond auction raising money for the botanical gardens.

facts.text: Master Bruce, I made soup. A hot meal in a cold world is no small thing.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as a character line, so it counts as a quote. Not a line Alfred says. IMDb quotes would not load, and nothing in the plot sources matches it. Alfred is ill with MacGregor's syndrome and hides it, so a written note in his voice can lean on the cold.
facts.fix: Master Bruce, I made soup. Eat it while it's hot, the city is turning cold.

fix_note.text: Master Bruce, I made soup. Eat it while it's hot, the city is turning cold.

vibe.verdict: Clever in-room dining idea with good dish names, but the quiet cream hotel look fights the film's neon camp and the cue is shaky.
